thread.title: Loop Capital boosts Apple target on second-half prospects - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) | Seeking Alpha

author: Jason Aycock
title: Loop Capital boosts Apple target on second-half prospects - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) | Seeking Alpha
text:
Loop Capital has raised its price target on Apple ( AAPL +0.6% ) on what it sees as good positioning going into the second half with an expected fall phone update ahead.
Analyst Ananda Baruah raised the firm's price target to $210 from $195, pointing to momentum in services and the expectation of tailwinds from an LCD-based version of the iPhone X that would have a lower ASP. Baruah says the company's last $100B buyback could add about $1.60 to EPS as well. (h/t Bloomberg)
Loop's target implies 12.6% upside.
Apple shares are up 28.7% over the past 12 months. They're up 9.6% YTD.
